Generation Impuls sucht Verstärkung! Für unseren Partner – eine der am schnellsten wachsenden Neo-Banken Europas mit Sitz in Amsterdam – suchen wir starke Profile für den deutschen Markt. In dieser Rolle bist du weit mehr als klassischer Kundenservice: Du bist das Aushängeschild der Bank, Problemlöser und das entscheidende Bindeglied zwischen unseren Nutzern und der Technik.
Aufgaben

Der direkte Kontakt: Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere deutschsprachigen Privat- und Geschäftskunden. Du begleitest sie beim digitalen Onboarding, erklärst App-Funktionen und hilfst bei der Kontoeinrichtung.
Troubleshooting: Kunden melden sich bei dir wegen verlorener Karten, vergessener PINs oder Fragen zu aktuellen Abbuchungen. Du reagierst schnell, kompetent und absolut lösungsorientiert.
KYC & Sicherheit: Du unterstützt bei Fragen zum Identifikationsverfahren (Know Your Customer) und gibst verlässliche Hilfestellungen bei gesperrten Konten oder Sicherheitswarnungen.

Komplexe Fälle: Du übernimmst die Tickets, die im 1st Level nicht sofort gelöst werden können. Dazu gehören detaillierte Zahlungsnachverfolgungen (SEPA/SWIFT), Chargebacks und unklare Transaktionsfehler.
Schnittstellenarbeit: Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit internen Fachabteilungen wie Compliance, Fraud Prevention und der IT, um tiefgreifende Account-Probleme zu eskalieren und nachhaltig zu lösen.
Prozessoptimierung: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Muster, dokumentierst Bugs sauber im System und hilfst proaktiv dabei, unsere internen FAQs und Service-Workflows weiter zu verschlanke
Qualifikation
Sprachen: Dein Deutsch ist fehlerfrei in Wort und Schrift (C1/C2) und du sprichst fließend Englisch. Unsere gesamte interne Firmenkommunikation sowie die Software-Systeme laufen auf Englisch.
Erfahrung: Du hast nachweisbare Berufserfahrung im kundennahen Umfeld (Customer Care, Support, Backoffice) – idealerweise im Bereich Finanzen, E-Commerce oder bei einem Tech-Start-up.
Klartext statt Floskeln: Du redest nicht um den heißen Brei herum. Du kannst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Sachverhalte einfach und verständlich erklären – direkt, transparent und ohne überflüssige Phrasen.
Tech-Affinität: Du arbeitest sicher in digitalen, cloud-basierten Umgebungen. Du nutzt mühelos moderne CRM- und Ticketsysteme und behältst auch bei mehreren geöffneten Fenstern souverän den Überblick.
Stressresistenz: Im Banking geht es um das Geld unserer Kunden. Du bleibst professionell, verbindlich und empathisch, auch wenn die Situation am anderen Ende der Leitung einmal hitzig wird.

Internationales Umfeld: Ein moderner Arbeitsplatz wahlweise im Zentrum von Amsterdam oder an einem unserer deutschen Standorte – verbunden mit einem durchweg internationalen Team.
Klare Strukturen: Bei uns gibt es keine langen Debatten oder verstaubte Banken-Hierarchien. Wir schätzen klare operative Grenzen, unmittelbare Verantwortlichkeit und schnelle Entscheidungen.
Modernes Setup: State-of-the-Art Equipment für reibungslose, digitale Arbeitsabläufe.
Wachstum: Ein fundiertes Onboarding und die echte Chance, in einem schnell skalierenden Fintech mitzuwachsen und dich intern weiterzuentwickeln.
Passt das zu dir?
Dann verlier keine Zeit. Schick uns direkt deine Unterlagen durch – wir freuen uns darauf, zu sehen, wer du bist!

Reports to: Sr. Customer Service Manager

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Customer Service Manager to lead our Customer Service and Order Management team. In this role, you will drive solution-oriented decision-making, collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, and ensure orders are processed accurately and efficiently. You will play a key part in shaping our overall customer service and order-to-cash strategy, ensuring a seamless process and an exceptional customer experience at every touchpoint.

Team Leadership & Development: Oversee the hiring, onboarding, and continuous training of customer service staff to build a capable, motivated, and high-performing team.
Performance Management: Define, track, and analyze functional KPIs and improvement targets. Utilize lean management tools to drive action plans and address performance gaps.
Policy & Process Optimization: Develop, enhance, and implement customer service policies, procedures, and standards that ensure compliance while maximizing customer satisfaction.
Customer Engagement: Proactively communicate with customers to understand their needs and expectations, and make appropriate adjustments to meet them. Serve as the primary escalation point for complex or unresolved issues, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution.
Operational Efficiency: Identify and implement automation opportunities within daily customer service workflows to improve productivity and efficiency.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Liaise daily with internal stakeholders including Commercial, Logistics, Planning, Finance, Quality, IT, Legal, and HR to support operational matters and project initiatives.
Stakeholder Communication: Regularly communicate business updates, risks, and opportunities to senior management. Interact with external customers, third-party service providers, and IT system consultants as needed.
Audit & Compliance: Support internal audit activities and ensure departmental operations adhere to all applicable regulations and company policies.

Education: Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Business, Finance, or a related field is required. Significant relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
Experience: Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in Customer Service, Order Management, or Sales Operations, with proven people management and leadership experience .
Technical Skills: Deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA .
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (data analysis, reporting, modeling).
Core Competencies: Strong leadership and team-building capabilities.
Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving and cross-functional coordination abilities.
Deep understanding of the end-to-end quote-to-cash process.

Advanced Utility Systems, a division of Harris; is seeking a Vice President of Customer Support who leads the customer support organization with full accountability for strategic direction, operational execution, service quality, customer retention, and cost-to-serve performance.
This executive owns the complete support lifecycle, from first-contact ticket resolution and after-hours incident response through quality assurance, root cause analysis, workforce planning, and the delivery of premium support services for customers who require elevated engagement.
The VP of Customer Support reports to the Senior Vice President of Operations and serves as a peer to the Executive Leadership Team.

The role requires a leader who can translate company strategy into daily operating discipline, align support capacity with customer demand, and apply data, process improvement, and modern support technology to improve customer outcomes while reducing avoidable effort.

The VP brings the voice of the customer into product development, advocates for software quality as a primary lever for improving customer satisfaction and reducing cost to serve, and partners with engineering to address recurring defects and systemic issues at their source.
A central expectation of the role is to lead the practical adoption of AI tools, technologies, and operating insights across Customer Support.

The VP will identify high-value use cases for AI-enabled triage, knowledge retrieval, agent assistance, case summarization, deflection, quality monitoring, and workflow automation; establish the best practices required for safe and effective adoption; and measure impact through operational metrics, with particular emphasis on lowering cost to serve without compromising customer experience.
The successful candidate must bring deep knowledge of software support operations and direct experience managing cost through scalable delivery models, including nearshoring.

This includes building the right mix of onshore, nearshore, and specialized technical capacity; maintaining accountability for quality and responsiveness across geographies; and using workforce design, process discipline, automation, and AI-assisted practices to improve efficiency at scale.

The VP will establish a disciplined operating cadence built around service levels, response times, resolution times, backlog management, cost per ticket, and other key support performance indicators, with accountability for sustained operational improvement.
This role also carries responsibility for building a premium support service portfolio, including Customer Success Management, targeted at the portion of the customer base that requires and will invest in elevated service. Contribution to customer retention, renewal outcomes, and lead generation for the Sales organization are standing accountabilities of this team.
This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US with a preference for Canada and Greater Toronto Area. Travel is required as needed, approximately 50%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean. Preference will be given to candidates who can work in EST timezone.

AI & Innovation Mindset
We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency.

Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

Oversee the full inbound support operation across all channels and customer tiers, define and enforce service level agreements, and manage escalation paths for complex or high-risk issues to ensure consistent, high-rate ticket closure.
Lead the company's after-hours support function and production incident response capability, including on-call coverage models, escalation runbooks, and customer communication protocols; drive post-incident reviews and ensure findings feed back into operational and product improvements in coordination with DevOpps and R&D leaders.
Design and maintain a formal QA program for the support organization, define quality standards, implement ticket review processes, and use QA data to coach staff and identify training needs. Ensure quality and operational reviews incorporate service levels, response performance, resolution performance, ticket backlog health, and adherence to support processes.
Analyze support data to identify recurring product defects and customer friction points, deliver structured root cause analysis to the VP of Research and Development on a regular cadence, and advocate for engineering investment in software quality improvements. Drive reduction of aged ticket backlog, ticket debt, and repeat customer incidents through formal problem management practices.
Partner with the VP of Research and Development as a peer and standing voice of the customer in product planning, and quantify the relationship between software quality and support cost to prioritize defect resolution alongside feature development.
Design, deliver, and continuously improve a premium support service portfolio for the segment of the customer base that requires elevated service, including Customer Success Management and dedicated technical account management programs with defined outcomes and measurable margin contribution.
Monitor customer health signals across the support organization, identify at-risk accounts, coordinate retention efforts, and route customers showing expansion interest to the Sales team as qualified leads.
Develop business cases for new premium service offerings and bring viable concepts to the leadership team with a proposed delivery model, pricing rationale, and go-to-market approach.
Drive the adoption and maturation of AI-enabled support tools across the organization, including automated triage, intelligent deflection, agent co-pilot tools, and knowledge retrieval, with a focus on production deployment at scale and measurable reduction in cost per ticket. Establish expectations, reporting, and operational metrics that demonstrate utilization and business impact of AI-enabled support capabilities.
Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing team of support managers, technical support engineers, quality analysts, and customer success managers, and build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Report on support performance, service portfolio health, and retention outcomes to the SVP of Operations and senior leadership team, and contribute to operational strategy as a member of the leadership team. Maintain executive visibility into key support indicators including service levels, first response performance, resolution times, backlog trends, customer satisfaction, productivity, and cost-to-serve performance.

The Assistant Chief is instrumental in assisting the Chief, CEVE to develop, manage, and coordinate all aspects of the facility's patient experience, patient centered care, cultural transformation, and customer satisfaction outcomes and measures.

The Assistant Chief is responsible for developing tools and methods, manage existing tools and methods, collecting and analyzing results, interpreting results, and communicating results of all patient experience and customer feedback to clinical and administrative services within the Ralph H.

Johnson VA Medical Center, sites of care directly under its control, and as needed, other sites of care which may include Vet Centers, VISN VA sites, National VA sites, and Community Care.

The incumbent is also responsible for working with clinical and administrative staff to develop and implement process improvements, produce and monitor action plans used to improve patient experience scores, and report patient experience scores, action plans, and outcomes for presentation to facility leadership.

The Assistant Chief will serve as the facility expert in patient experience and customer satisfaction tools including, but not limited to Press Ganey, Veteran Signals, SHEP, secret shopper programs, PATS data management, comment cards, phone and kiosk surveys, and all other reporting measures related to patient experience and customer satisfaction.

The incumbent is directly and through subordinate staff responsible for contributing to survey design and development, sampling distributions, clinic and provider updates, managing sampling recommendations, reviewing and modifying survey distributions based on clinic and provider workload, and all other aspects necessary to ensure that all patient experience data is valid, accurate, up-to-date, and actionable.

The Assistant Chief will oversee all contract development, oversight, and actions related to patient experience and customer feedback contracts within the facility.

The incumbent will work with contractors, clinicians, and administrators to develop standard and customized survey and data collection tools and solutions essential in evaluating, trending, prioritizing and improving areas within the facility that impact patient experience and customer satisfaction.

The Assistant Chief provides administrative direction, day-to day supervision, and general objectives to achieve success through the facility Veteran's Experience Program.

Company Description
Lingraphica is a mission-driven organization that provides speech-generating devices to help improve communication, speech, and quality of life for people with communication impairments.

Lingraphica is a leader in augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) technology, helping people with aphasia and other speech and language impairments communicate and engage more fully in daily life.

Through a combination of innovative devices, software, and services, Lingraphica is focused on improving communication outcomes and supporting individuals, families, and care teams. We look for candidates who enjoy working in a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment, and who share our commitment to helping individuals on their communication journey.
Job Description
Purpose : The Customer Service Specialist (CSS) successfully works with prospects and existing customers by offering a world-class experience throughout all points of contact. This role collaborates cross-functionally with teams across Lingraphica’s business units to improve customer-facing channels.

The CSS is responsible for addressing non-product inquiries, resolving Tier 1 issues, and properly triaging and escalating customer concerns. Tier 1 issues include basic troubleshooting for all Lingraphica products such as free apps, customer accounts, and devices.

This position is responsible for providing exceptional customer service in a timely manner.

Maintains knowledge of all product enhancements, website improvements, marketing campaigns, and other developments that may impact frontline volume across all channels
Comfortably interacts with prospects and existing customers by providing a superb experience to both create and maintain relationships/partnerships
Identifies and provides a resolution for Tier 1 product issues Lingraphica customers are experiencing
Proactively follows up with customers to ensure their concerns are resolved
Communicates with potential and existing customers through multiple platforms including inbound calls, outbound calls, e-mail and online chat
Monitors and reports customer inquiry trends, recurring issues, and frontline insights using CRM data to support operational improvements and enhance the customer experience.
Effectively liaises with key functions such as Reimbursement, Funding & Benefits, and Product Support to improve customer-facing processes or services
Recognizes opportunities to support customer progression by identifying potential engagement needs and ensuring timely handoff to the appropriate team.
Manages frontline activities using a ticket system to document issues, opportunities, and “transfers” to departments for follow-up
Assists with de-escalating customer service matters including but not limited to:
Technical issues with our devices, websites, online therapy platform
Shipping
Provides support to other customer service areas such as communication partner training, and product support teams
Provides education on Lingraphica's products, services, and trial process while identifying engagement opportunities and appropriately connecting prospective customers with the Intake & Engagement team for consultative follow-up.
Maintains an expert knowledge of Lingraphica devices, accessories, web programs, and mobile applications
Maintains an understanding of the pre-trial sales journey and collaborates with Intake & Engagement and Trial Onboarding teams to ensure a seamless customer experience across all pre-trial touchpoints.
Conduct proactive customer outreach from designated campaign lists to check in on customers' communication progress, device experience, and support needs, connecting them with additional services, technical resources, or other appropriate next steps when applicable.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
Curious thinker with a desire to improve existing processes
Excellent communication skills (written, verbal and listening)
Ability to assist individuals who have aphasia and other speech/language challenges with empathy and compassion
Able and eager to deliver a positive customer experience
Excellent time management and multi-tasking skills
Ability to perform above expectations in a fastpaced and dynamic environment
Teamwork, especially as an expert at getting things done, all with a positive attitude

Bachelor’s Degree, preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience
2 years Customer Service experience, required

About the Program: Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online.

Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry. Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program.

Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program. We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements: This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike!

Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying: Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work Apprenticeship Program Learnings: Build digital products and services 0-1 Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management Identify target market for product and position product for launch success Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply: The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply - we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort.

Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

Proactive approach to problem-solving and follow-up.
Experience working with EDI, customer portals, and/or ERP systems is a plus.
Ability to communicate effectively with both customers and internal departments.
Good organizational and time-management skills.

Join DOE's Power Up program and kickstart your federal career! This program is designed to offer exciting early-career opportunities for upcoming professionals ready to make an impact in the Federal government.

As a participant, you will be paired with an on-the-job mentor whose guidance is tailored specifically to your career path-whether you are entering a technical specialty or an administrative/professional role. In this program, mentoring goes far beyond basic job training.

Your mentor will serve as a trusted guide, helping you build confidence, develop professional skills, and learn how to navigate and thrive within a structured, mission-driven environment. As a Power Up Intern in the Hydrocarbons and Geothermal Energy Office (HGEO), you will support our daily mission goals.

Your responsibilities at the GS-5 grade level may include: Assisting higher-graded analysts in conducting routine program evaluations and performing basic monitoring of administrative support systems, such as Workday, records, and documentation.

Conducting preliminary research and checking administrative files to verify that factual information and documentation are accurate and complete. Performing entry-level quantitative and qualitative data entry and compilation to assist in the preparation of routine, recurring program reports.

Providing administrative support, entering data into tracking systems, and directing routine inquiries from internal and external stakeholders to the appropriate staff.

Your responsibilities at the GS-7 grade level may include: Coordinating and carrying out well-defined evaluation tasks to determine program effectiveness, while independently monitoring administrative systems, records, and documentation.

Researching, reviewing, and evaluating documentation to determine its relevance, accuracy, and usefulness for program decisions. Conducting independent data analysis of limited complexity on workforce programs using quantitative and qualitative methods and drafting complete reports to convey factual program data.

Preparing formal reports and correspondence and serving as a primary point of contact to resolve inquiries from internal and external stakeholders regarding talent and performance management programs.
You must meet all qualifications and eligibility requirements by the closing date (08/26/2026) of this announcement.

For the GS-05: You must have 3 years of progressively responsible general experience, 1 year of which was equivalent to at least the GS-04, that demonstrates the ability to: Analyze problems to identify significant factors, gather pertinent data, and recognize solutions; Plan and organize work; and Communicate effectively orally and in writing.

Such experience may have been gained in administrative, professional, technical, investigative, or other responsible work.

Experience in substantive and relevant secretarial, clerical, or other responsible work may be qualifying as long as it provided evidence of the knowledge, skills, and abilities (KSA's) necessary to perform the duties of the position to be filled.

OR YOU MAY QUALIFY FOR THE GS-5 BASED ON EDUCATION: 4-year course of study leading to a bachelor's degree. Education must still show the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform in this position.

OR YOU MAY QUALIFY FOR THE GS-5 BASED ON A COMBINATION OF EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE: If you have some qualifying education and some qualifying experience, but don't fully meet either requirement on its own, you may be able to combine them. Divide your qualifying semester hours by 120. That gives you your education percentage.

Divide your years of qualifying experience by years required. That gives you your experience percentage. Add the two together. If the total is 100% or more, you qualify. For the GS-07: You must have one year of specialized experience at a level of difficulty and responsibility equivalent to the GS-05 grade level in the Federal Service.

Specialized experience for this position at the GS-7 includes: Entering, updating, and maintaining personnel, program, or business records within an electronic database or administrative tracking system.; AND Extracting and verifying factual data from spreadsheets, reports, or files to draft routine summaries or standard reports.; AND Preparing standard business correspondence and responding to inquiries from internal and external stakeholders.

OR YOU MAY QUALIFY FOR THE GS-7 BASED ON EDUCATION: 1 full year of graduate level education. Education must still show the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform in this position.

OR YOU MAY QUALIFY FOR THE GS-7 BASED ON SUPERIOR ACADEMIC ACHIEVEMENT: A bachelor's degree AND meet one of the following: (1) Class standing -- You must be in the upper third of the graduating class in the college, university, or major subdivision based on completed courses; OR (2) Grade-point average (G.P.A.) -- You must have 3.0 or higher out of a possible 4.0 based on 4 years of education, or as computed based on courses completed during the final 2 years of the curriculum OR 3.5 or higher out of a possible 4.0 based on the average of the required courses completed in the major field or the required courses in the major field completed during the final 2 years of the curriculum; OR (3) Election to membership in a national scholastic honor society (other than freshman honor societies) -- You are a member of one of the national scholastic honor societies recognized by the Association of College Honor Societies (https://www.achshonor.org/).

The bachelor's degree must still show the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform in this position. OR YOU MAY QUALIFY FOR THE GS-7 BASED ON A COMBINATION OF EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE: If you have some qualifying education and some qualifying experience, but don't fully meet either requirement on its own, you may be able to combine them.

Only graduate education can be used in this calculation. Experience must be reflected in your resume, and transcripts are required. Divide your qualifying graduate semester hours by 18. That gives you your education percentage. Divide your months of qualifying experience by 12. That gives you your experience percentage. Add the two together.

If the total is 100% or more, you qualify. Education must be obtained from an accredited institution recognized by the U.S. Department of Education. Experience may include paid or unpaid work, including internships, volunteer service, student leadership, military service, apprenticeships, or other relevant activities.

Resumes must clearly describe duties, dates, and hours worked per week.

Obsidian Security is the leading SaaS security platform, trusted by global enterprises like Snowflake, T-Mobile, and Algolia. We protect 200+ organizations across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand, including many of the world’s largest Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 companies.
Founded in 2017 and backed by top investors like Greylock, Obsidian was built to close a critical gap: securing SaaS apps where business happens—Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and hundreds more. The company does this by offering a complete SaaS security platform to reduce risk, detect and respond to threats, and prevent breaches at the source.

Obsidian was built by leaders who redefined endpoint and identity security at CrowdStrike, Okta, Cylance, and Carbon Black. Now, they’re transforming how SaaS is secured.
With AI driving rapid SaaS growth and complexity, agentic AI tools gain privileged access to sensitive data through integrations, creating new risks most security tools miss. Obsidian uniquely detects anomalous OAuth token activity and manages integration risks. Major announcements are on the horizon. Recognizing that SaaS security needs to evolve, Obsidian enables growing organizations to start with a lightweight, prevention-focused browser extension and expand coverage over time.
With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and a major fundraise ahead, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness.

Obsidian Security protects organizations against threats across their SaaS and identity environments. As we scale, we are deliberately rethinking how technical support is delivered. We are not looking to grow this function by adding headcount in proportion to ticket volume. We are looking to scale it through systems, automation, and agentic AI.
This role owns that transition. You will re-architect the support operating model around technology to resolve the majority of customer issues through automated and agentic systems rather than human effort. Traditional people-management experience is welcome, but is not what we are optimizing for. We are looking for an operator who has already built and run technology-led support at scale.

Own the support operating model and redesign it around automation and agentic AI rather than linear headcount growth.
Design, deploy, and continuously improve agentic support systems across the full lifecycle: triage, resolution, escalation, and follow-up.
Build the knowledge and data infrastructure these systems depend on, including knowledge bases, retrieval systems, and the telemetry that feeds them.
Define and instrument the metrics that prove the model works: deflection rate, automated resolution rate, cost-to-serve, time-to-resolution, and CSAT.
Integrate support tooling with the product, internal systems, and customer telemetry so that resolution becomes increasingly automated over time.
Partner with Product and Engineering to convert recurring support signals into product fixes and self-service capabilities.
Maintain support quality and SLAs for a technical cybersecurity customer base throughout the transition.
Lead a small, high-leverage team of support and automation engineers, hiring for technical and systems capability.

A demonstrated track record of operationalizing agentic AI or automation in a technical support environment, with measurable deflection and cost-to-serve outcomes.
A strong systems and engineering orientation. You are comfortable with APIs, integrations, data pipelines, LLM-based tooling, and support platform configuration.
Experience supporting a technical B2B SaaS product. Cybersecurity, identity, or SaaS security context is strongly preferred.
Fluency in support of economics and the metrics that govern cost-to-serve and scale.
The ability to own and execute the technical roadmap for the support function end-to-end.
What this role is not
This is not a traditional people-management or org-scaling role. We are explicitly optimizing for someone who scales the function through systems and automation rather than linear headcount growth.

The role has full autonomy to add headcount, but the purpose of that headcount is to improve the strategic delivery of the support model and to handle tier-three escalation management, not to absorb ticket volume. Conventional support-leadership experience is valued but secondary to demonstrated technical and automation capability.

An engineering or technical IC background.
Direct experience building or integrating LLM and agent frameworks.
Prior hands-on support engineering experience in a security or infrastructure product.

Bilingual Medical Scheduling & Patient Support Specialist
Remote | Gastroenterology | Part-Time, 40 hours/week | Rate: $6.5/hour

This Gastroenterology practice is looking for a highly organized, patient-focused Bilingual Medical Scheduling & Patient Support Specialist to support its clinics in two locations in Texas.
This role is heavily focused on appointment scheduling and patient communication , with a high daily call volume of approximately 70 to 90 calls per day . The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced healthcare environment, managing multiple communication channels, and maintaining accurate patient documentation.

1. Appointment Scheduling
Handle approximately 70 to 90 inbound and outbound calls daily related to appointments for the Lewisville and Denton locations.
Schedule, reschedule, and cancel patient appointments while ensuring accurate and timely communication with patients.
Maintain and update provider schedules in RingCentral and eClinicalWorks (eCW) based on availability and scheduling requirements.
2. Fax Management
Send and receive faxes involving patient records, referrals, insurance documents, and other clinical or administrative information.
Review incoming fax communications and route documents to the appropriate provider, department, or patient record.
Accurately log, upload, and organize faxed documentation within the clinic's systems.
3. Language Interpretation Support
Provide occasional language interpretation assistance between patients and clinic staff when needed.
Help ensure medical and administrative information is communicated clearly and accurately across language barriers.
Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and accuracy when assisting with patient-provider communication.
4. Outbound Calling
Conduct outbound calls for appointment reminders, follow-ups, patient updates, and care coordination.
Contact insurance companies, referring providers, pharmacies, or other healthcare offices when necessary.
Document call outcomes, follow-up requirements, and relevant information accurately in the patient's record.
5. Patient Text Messaging
Send appointment confirmations, reminders, updates, and other approved patient communications through text messaging.
Monitor and collect patient responses and escalate questions or concerns to the appropriate clinic team member when needed.
Document relevant text conversations and patient responses in RingCentral and eCW to maintain continuity of care.
6. Billing and Payment Reminder Support
Contact patients regarding outstanding balances, billing reminders, or upcoming payment obligations as instructed by the clinic.
Provide basic payment-related information and direct patients to the appropriate billing resource when additional assistance is required.

Previous experience in medical administration, medical virtual assistance, patient scheduling, front desk support, or a similar healthcare role is strongly preferred.
Comfortable handling a high-volume call environment , including approximately 70 to 90 calls per day.
Experience using eClinicalWorks (eCW) and RingCentral is highly preferred.
Strong verbal and written English communication skills with a professional and patient-friendly approach.
Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and ability to manage multiple tasks throughout the workday.
Experience supporting a gastroenterology or specialty medical practice is an advantage.
Ability to communicate in an additional language and provide interpretation support is an advantage.
Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is confident speaking with patients throughout the day, comfortable managing a high volume of appointments and communications, and able to stay organized while supporting two clinic locations. You should be dependable, detail-oriented, professional, and capable of providing a positive patient experience while maintaining accurate documentation.
